description: Patients with anterior prefrontal lesions performed perception and memory tasks as well as controls, but their confidence ratings tracked accuracy less well for perception, not for memory (Fleming et al. 2014, as reported by Odegaard, Knight and Lau).
limitations: Reported secondhand. The original study is not among the sources read. Lesions were incomplete and the measure is metacognitive accuracy, not awareness directly.

sources.quote: This observed effect was not due to an impairment of general ability for introspection, as it was specific to perception but not memory
